fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami municipal governance and finances, including a proposed recall of the city commission and criticism of city spending (notably the purchase of automobiles). Reports and opinion pieces address Dade County public school budget curtailments, local enforcement and corruption concerns related to prohibition, and police/court activity. The issue also covers public fascination with the performer/soothsayer Gene Dennis at the Olympia Theatre and references the Billy McAllister kidnapping case, alongside society/entertainment notes and local advertisements.
